_**Agent (composer-2-fast)**_

Here’s what’s going on.

## 1. **Padding stacks (main “looks off” cause)**

Your `Card` is built to keep **horizontal** spacing on the inner pieces, not on the root:

```10:11:components/ui/card.tsx
        "bg-card text-card-foreground flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-xl border py-6 shadow-sm",
```

`CardHeader`, `CardContent`, and `CardFooter` each add `px-6`. In `grid-item` you also add **`p-6` on the root `Card`** for non-map variants:

```48:50:components/public/grid-item.tsx
            <Card className={cn("size-full min-h-0 min-w-0 overflow-hidden bg-card rounded-4xl", className, {
                "text-card-foreground p-6 bg-card": variant !== "map",
```

So you get **card padding + section `px-6`**, i.e. **double horizontal inset**. That often reads as “too tight” or uneven compared to the [shadcn Card docs](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/radix/card), where the root usually only has vertical padding (`py-6`) and the sides are handled once by header/content/footer.

**Fix direction:** drop root `p-6` for project cards and rely on `py-6` + the subcomponents’ `px-6`, or drop the inner `px-6` via `className` overrides if you want padding only on the outer `Card`.

---

## 2. **`CardHeader` + `flex flex-col` fights the layout**

Default `CardHeader` is a **grid** so title/description sit in one column and `CardAction` in the top-right:

```22:24:components/ui/card.tsx
      className={cn(
        "@container/card-header grid auto-rows-min grid-rows-[auto_auto] items-start gap-2 px-6 has-data-[slot=card-action]:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] [.border-b]:pb-6",
```

You override with `flex flex-col`:

```54:54:components/public/grid-item.tsx
                        <CardHeader className="flex flex-col">
```

That removes the grid, so **`CardAction`’s column placement** (`col-start-2`, etc.) no longer does what the component expects. The action often stacks or aligns oddly instead of sitting in the header’s top-right.

**Fix direction:** remove `flex flex-col` from `CardHeader` (or only add classes that don’t replace the grid).

---

## 3. **Tight grid cells**

`PortfolioGrid` uses `react-grid-layout` with fixed row heights. The card is `flex flex-col gap-6` with multiple sections plus a bottom `ShowMoreButton`. In a short cell, **`gap-6` + padding + overflow-hidden** can clip content or feel cramped—less “Card looks wrong” and more “not enough vertical space for this Card API.”

---

**TL;DR:** The Card isn’t broken; it’s **stacking outer `p-6` with inner `px-6`**, and **`CardHeader` is overridden in a way that breaks `CardAction`’s grid layout.** Aligning padding with the shadcn pattern and restoring the default header layout usually fixes the visual issues.
